name: io.github.HamSanders/mirli
title: Mirli
description: Local AI sound effects, music, speech and voice cloning on your own GPU. Returns WAV paths.

environmentVariables.name: SOUNDBOX_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional access token (16+ characters). When set, send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

environmentVariables.name: SOUNDBOX_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated extra Host names /mcp accepts, for reaching it by a name other than localhost.
